entry.name: print
entry.digest: Print any message in the Max Console
entry.description: print will print any input into the Max Console for debugging, messaging, or analysis purposes. Selecting "Show Output" from the Object Action Menu opens the sidebar Max console and filters output to only show posts from the print object.

arguments.name: identifier
arguments.description: The argument is an identifier for theobject. Each message printed in the Max Console is preceded by the name of theobject. The name can be either a number or a word. If there is no argument, the name of theobject is. Using an argument tocan help distinguish the output of two or moreobjects.

attributes.digest: Alert Level
attributes.description: Selects the style of text displayed in the Max Console. Except for thestyle, these styles are only used for display, and have no additional meaning in Max. Messages displayed using thestyle will also appear at anyobjects in the patcher.Four styles are available: Print (0), Warn (1), Error (2), Bug (3)
